name: know-your-code
description: Your AI code companion for understanding complex codebases, debugging logic, and exploring functions faster in VS code, Cursor, and Antigravity

enumDescriptions: Local model via Ollama or compatible API
knowYourCode.activeProvider.description: Preferred AI provider when choosing among multiple configured models.

knowYourCode.openai.enabled.description: Enable OpenAI in the KYC model picker.

knowYourCode.openai.apiKey.description: API key for OpenAI. Get one at platform.openai.com.

knowYourCode.openai.modelName.description: Preferred OpenAI model to preselect in the KYC model picker.

knowYourCode.claude.apiKey.description: API key for Anthropic Claude. Get one at console.anthropic.com.

knowYourCode.claude.enabled.description: Enable Anthropic Claude in the KYC model picker.

knowYourCode.claude.modelName.description: Preferred Claude model to preselect in the KYC model picker.

knowYourCode.gemini.apiKey.description: API key for Google Gemini. Get one at aistudio.google.com.

knowYourCode.gemini.enabled.description: Enable Google Gemini in the KYC model picker.

knowYourCode.gemini.modelName.description: Preferred Gemini model to preselect in the KYC model picker.

knowYourCode.localEndpoint.description: Local model endpoint (e.g., Ollama generate API).

knowYourCode.localEnabled.description: Enable the local model option in the KYC model picker.

knowYourCode.localModelName.description: Model name for the local provider.

knowYourCode.prefetchConnectedCalls.description: Automatically prefetch explanations for direct callees after explaining a function.

knowYourCode.cacheTtlSeconds.description: Optional TTL for cached explanations in seconds. Set to 0 to keep cache entries until the code, dependency graph, or model changes.

knowYourCode.selectionDebounceMs.description: Debounce window for rapid repeated explanation requests. In-flight requests for the same function/model are also deduplicated.

knowYourCode.inlineActionsEnabled.description: Show context-aware KYC inline actions using CodeLens near the current selection or enclosing function.

knowYourCode.incremental.enabled.description: Enable incremental explanations: when a small edit is made to a large function, only send the diff to the AI model instead of the full code. Saves tokens and reduces latency.

knowYourCode.incremental.minFunctionLine.description: Minimum function size (in lines) for incremental explain to activate. Functions smaller than this always use the full explain path.

knowYourCode.incremental.maxChangeRatio.description: Maximum ratio of changed lines to total lines for incremental explain. Edits changing more than this fraction of the function fall back to full explain. Scales up for larger functions.

knowYourCode.incremental.maxChangedLines.description: Absolute maximum number of changed lines for incremental explain.

knowYourCode.incremental.maxChangedRegio.description: Maximum number of disjoint changed regions in the function. Scattered changes beyond this limit fall back to full explain. Scales up for larger functions.

knowYourCode.incremental.contextLines.description: Number of surrounding context lines to include around each change in the diff sent to the AI model.

knowYourCode.incremental.maxIncrementalD.description: Maximum number of consecutive incremental updates before forcing a full re-explain. Prevents quality drift from accumulated incremental updates.

knowYourCode.cursorHandoff.description: Route KYC commands to the detected AI chat panel instead of built-in providers. KYC auto-enables this whenever any AI signal is detected (AI IDE, AI assistant extension, or registered LM API model). Set to true to force-enable even without detected AI.
